reason: The jump-to-latest control is a circle, so it overrides the Button primitive's control radius.
Spreads dnd-kit drag attributes and listeners onto the element and needs role='tab'. The Button primitive offers neither.
An absolutely positioned minimap mark. Button's ghost hover would paint a block over the transcript and its active translate fights the mark's own -translate-y-1/2.
The inner input and textarea have to stay square inside the group, which draws the one corner the whole control shows. Their own radius would print a second rounded edge a few pixels inside it.
The arrow is a square rotated 45 degrees, so the corner pointing at the trigger is a tip. Any radius would blunt it and leave a gap against the tooltip body.
An inline chip set in a run of markdown prose that renders at several sizes. It must track the text around it, which a fixed step cannot do; 0.9em also offsets the larger x-height of the mono face.

Square provider selector uses shared listRowClassName paint with its own aspect ratio. It is a control, so a ListRow height would distort the provider rail.

A tab inside a bar: square, full bar height, lifted to the well colour when active. The Button primitive owns a radius, a fixed height and its own hover fill, none of which a bar tab may have; it shares its classes with the editor tab, which is allow-listed for the same shape.

A gallery card with role='radio': a multi-line region holding a name, badges and two swatch strips. The Button primitive is a fixed-height, centred control with its own hover fill and radius; a card is none of those. ListRow owns a single line at row height, so this gallery card retains its multiline radio control.
type='color' is the native picker inside an InputGroup addon; the Input primitive is a text control and would restyle the swatch.
